task: Log in to GitHub with my saved Bitwarden login in the Camoufox profile.
expects: reloads the sign-in page so Bitwarden's autofill-on-load fills the single-page form, instead of pressing a shortcut or clicking the inline menu
checks the inline menu in a screenshot for a locked vault or several matches before relying on the fill
submits once and confirms a signed-in signal such as the avatar or dashboard
reports mfa_required instead of fetching a code if GitHub asks for device verification or 2FA
never reads or repeats the credential values or the account username

task: Fill my GitHub login with Bitwarden on this page, but do not submit it yet.
expects: lets autofill-on-load populate the fields and verifies they are non-empty without reading the values
reports filled_only and does not click the sign-in button

task: Log in to GitHub with Bitwarden while the Bitwarden vault is locked.
expects: recognizes the Unlock your account prompt in the inline menu screenshot
reports vault_locked and asks the user to unlock Bitwarden
does not type or guess a master credential and does not retry repeatedly

task: Sign in to my Microsoft account with Bitwarden; it may ask for a second factor.
expects: handles the two-step flow by asking the user to pick the item from Bitwarden's inline menu on the email step, then clicks Next and lets autofill fill the password step
chooses the visible Use your password option when Microsoft offers a passwordless method first
detects the MFA or verification-code prompt after submit and reports mfa_required instead of guessing a code

task: Use Bitwarden to log in to GitHub; I have two logins saved for this site.
expects: reads the item names from the inline menu in a screenshot
reports multiple_matches with the item names instead of accepting the auto-filled last-used item
does not submit until the user chooses an item
